newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Charles Schwab lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Charles Schwab lowered.

text.p: CS First Boston said on Thursday it lowered its rating on the shares of Charles Schwab Corp to hold from buy.
-- Analyst Jim Marks said he lowered the rating mostly because of valuation.

-- Marks said he also lowered his 1997 earnings estimate to $1.51 per share from $1.55 per share and his 1998 estimate to $1.79 per share from $1.89 per share, based on events in the company's commission and trading lines.
-- Charles Schwab could see one more quarter of deterioration in its trading operations, but then this business should start to show modest growth, Marks said.
-- More of Charles Schwab's trades were being done electronically, which was slightly lowering the price per trade, but Marks said electronic trading would drive the company's future growth.
